fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is killed before implementation: no explicit scope family, overlap-hash matrix, target, or theorem converts cosystolic expansion into increased exact-fiber Hamming weight. Tiny scopes cannot test the claimed logarithmic asymptotic mechanism, and overlap coupling may simply recreate the charged-flow/local-view obstruction.

Proposal 2 is killed: for the fixed group of order 21, retaining every semisimple Fourier block is an invertible constant-size rewrite, while deleting blocks creates an unchecked kernel. Exhaustively choosing the best block subset post hoc supplies neither a deterministic instance rule nor scalable compression, and rank-metric distance does not by itself prove the required binary Hamming separation.

Proposal 3 is killed: a pure tensor of a minimum NO word is rank one at every flattening, exactly like a pure YES tensor. Rank condensers distinguish rank from zero rather than YES from NO support; restoring leaf costs reinstates the tensor-length wall, and no explicit condenser family or bounded search space is specified.

Proposal 4 is killed because its experiment obtains protected centers by brute-forcing isolated matchings, thereby assuming the NP-hard information the reduction must compute. BCH distance protects a known center, but neither computable center extraction nor a linear disjunction of sectors sound against superpositions is supplied.

Proposal 5 is killed as unspecified: there is no fixed presentation, formula-to-word map, cell dictionary, or explicit boundary matrix. Truncation can annihilate deep commutators, linear mod-2 fillings can cancel cheap legal fillings, and position labeling may make the alleged polynomial rank superpolynomial.

Proposal 6 is killed: ordered ABPs for arbitrary variable order can require exponential width, while polynomial relaxations do not enforce consistent repeated variable choices without returning to transcript/tableau interfaces. No direct Hankel syndrome matrix or rank-to-Hamming theorem is given, and computing minimal tiny ABPs does not test the asymptotic construction.

Proposal 7 remains blocked from any theorem: its walk count is polynomial only after an unstated bounded-incompatibility-degree reduction, and a collision does not activate a walk monomial unless every later walk vertex is also selected. Constant-component odd covers can therefore leave all long-walk coordinates zero, while arbitrary mixed Schur combinations may cancel still more coordinates.
evidence: The supplied exact mixed-word verifiers already show that sparse hashes, generator-type punctures, sampled products, and modular Kronecker folds lose soundness or fail frozen-family generalization. This makes all-mixed-word enumeration mandatory for any new partial Schur construction.

The proved pure-power dimension wall excludes treating Proposal 7 as ordinary exact Schur powering. Its restricted walk dictionary is not covered by that rank lower bound, so a bounded direct test remains informative.

The supplied quotient verifier finds illegal odd covers in the affine span of legal matchings, supporting the sector/filling warning: linear protection cannot distinguish such combinations without separately computable centers or a nonlinear classifier.

The current obstruction map does not universally exclude growing, formula-dependent walk scopes. Proposal 7 is the only sketch specifying enough of a polynomial map to test immediate localization and mixed-word cancellation without first assuming a witness.
Passing any finite walk test would establish only a finite coding signal. It would not prove polynomial rank, an asymptotic gap, NCP hardness, or the conditional CVP consequence.
next_experiment: Implement only Proposal 7. Freeze the existing q=3,m=8 YES/NO dictionaries plus deterministic 3DM images of the all-eight and odd-holonomy attacks; retain original triple coordinates and add every nonbacktracking incompatibility-walk monomial for lengths 2, 3, and primary length 4. Expand each lifted affine map symbolically over F2, row-reduce, enumerate every pointed mixed word, and record exact rank, output length, worst YES minimum, best NO minimum, and relabeling invariance. Kill unless the precommitted length-4 map has YES minimum 3, NO minimum strictly above 5 on every hostile instance, and a uniform log-gap divided by log output length strictly exceeding the unfurled base value; diagnostics at lengths 2 and 3 cannot rescue failure.
